problems.detail: challanToken (the guard against a late poll answer setting stale state) is only bumped in the unmount cleanup effect and at the start of a new openChallan() call; closing the sheet (onClose sets selected=null and challanNote=null) does not bump it. If the manager closes the load-sheet detail dialog while a poll is in flight and then reopens a different sheet within the ~60s window, the earlier poll's eventual answer can still fire documents.open(url) or setChallanNote('error') against the now-different sheet. Narrow window (bounded to 20 attempts / ~60s) and low impact (opens a PDF or shows a stray error note), so not a blocker/major, but it does not fully match the code's own comment that the token 'invalidates a poll in flight when the sheet is closed'.

onOpenPieces always resets piecesText to '' rather than pre-filling the row's current counts[line.id], so reopening the pieces sheet to check or correct an already-entered pick (e.g. re-open after typing 6) shows a blank field instead of '6'. Cosmetic only — the underlying count is untouched — not covered by the finding's test plan, so not a blocker.

blockers: DOS-026 (42f6bcb): frontend/manager-app/app/fulfilment/load-out.tsx:214-235 auto-opens the challan from the poll timer; on web documents.open is window.open (frontend/libs/ui/src/platform/documents.web.ts:19-21), and only attempt 0 (and maybe attempt 1 at ~3 s) still carries transient user activation. The render takes ~40 s, so the open lands on attempt >= 2 and every desk browser blocks the popup silently: the manager sees 'Preparing the challan…' for 40 s, the note clears, nothing opens — the finding's own symptom, delayed. Native is fine (download + share sheet, no gesture needed). Fix inside load-out.tsx plus one string: keep the ready URL in state (challanUrl); in the poll's open step call documents.open only when tries === 0, otherwise set challanUrl and a new m7.challanReady note; the button's onPress opens challanUrl synchronously (before any await) when set, else starts the poll; reset challanUrl with the note on close. nextChallanPoll and its three tests stay green either way.
